<DataTemplate x:Key="ContinousRunTemplate">
        <ContentPresenter Name="cp" ContentTemplate="{StaticResource ToolButtonDataTemplate}" Content="{Binding Items[0]}" />
        <DataTemplate.Triggers>
          <DataTrigger Value="True" Binding="{Binding Path=CustomItemData.(VMInterface:IVMRun.ContinuousRunEnable)}">
            <Setter TargetName="cp" Property="ContentPresenter.Content" Value="{Binding Items[1]}" />
          </DataTrigger>
          <MultiDataTrigger>
            <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
              <Condition Value="False" Binding="{Binding Path=CustomItemData.(VMInterface:IVMRun.ContinuousRunEnable)}" />
              <Condition Value="True" Binding="{Binding Path=CustomItemData.(VMInterface:IVMRun.IsRunning)}" />
            </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
            <Setter Property="UIElement.IsEnabled" Value="False" />
          </MultiDataTrigger>
          <DataTrigger Value="0" Binding="{Binding CustomItemData.Modules.Count}">
            <Setter Property="UIElement.IsEnabled" Value="False" />
          </DataTrigger>
          <DataTrigger Value="True" Binding="{Binding CustomItemData.IsOnExecuteAfterLoad}">
            <Setter Property="UIElement.IsEnabled" Value="False" />
          </DataTrigger>
        </DataTemplate.Triggers>
      </DataTemplate>

refs.member: DownPopTemplate: main-button predicate, child data context, popup and MouseDown command
refs.excerpt:
<DataTemplate x:Key="DownPopTemplate">
        <Grid>
          <Button Name="oo" Margin="4,0,4,0" Height="36" Width="36" Command="{Binding ItemClickCommand}" ToolTip="{Lang:ResourceBinding Name}">
            <FrameworkElement.Style>
              <Style TargetType="{x:Type Button}" BasedOn="{StaticResource ToolBarButtonStyle}">
                <Setter Property="IsEnabled" Value="False" />
                <Style.Triggers>
                  <MultiDataTrigger>
                    <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                      <Condition Value="True" Binding="{Binding CustomItemData.CanUndo}" />
                      <Condition Value="False" Binding="{Binding CustomItemData.LockAreaStatus}" />
                      <Condition Value="False" Binding="{Binding Path=RunData.(VMInterface:IVMRun.IsRunning)}" />
                    </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                    <MultiDataTrigger.Setters>
                      <Setter Property="IsEnabled" Value="True" />
                    </MultiDataTrigger.Setters>
                  </MultiDataTrigger>
                </Style.Triggers>
              </Style>
            </FrameworkElement.Style>
          </Button>
          <Grid Name="rightBottom" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" HorizontalAlignment="Right" DataContext="{Binding Items[0]}">
            <Image Width="16" Height="16">
              <FrameworkElement.Resources>
                <ResourceDictionary>
                  <Style x:Key="{x:Type Image}" TargetType="{x:Type Image}">
                    <Setter Property="Source" Value="{Binding ImageDisablePath}" />
                    <Style.Triggers>
                      <Trigger Property="UIElement.IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                        <Setter Property="FrameworkElement.Cursor" Value="Hand" />
                        <Setter Property="Source" Value="{Binding ImageEnablePath}" />
                      </Trigger>
                    </Style.Triggers>
                  </Style>
                </ResourceDictionary>
              </FrameworkElement.Resources>
            </Image>
            <Popup Name="Popup" AllowsTransparency="True" Width="150" Height="44" PopupAnimation="{DynamicResource {x:Static SystemParameters.MenuPopupAnimationKey}}" Placement="Bottom" HorizontalOffset="-24" IsOpen="{Binding IsMouseOver, ElementName=rightBottom, Mode=OneWay}">
              <StackPanel>
                <Grid Height="2" Background="#FF000000" Opacity="0" />
                <Grid Background="{DynamicResource ToolBarPopupGridBg}" Width="150" Height="42">
                  <Border CornerRadius="2" BorderThickness="1" Background="{DynamicResource Col_Menubar_Sub_Background}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource Col_Menubar_Sub_BorderBrush}">
                    <Grid Height="28" Background="#00FFFFFF">
                      <Grid>
                        <TextBlock Name="PART_Header" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Normal" Foreground="{DynamicResource Col_Menubar_Foreground}" HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="15,0,0,0" Text="{Lang:ResourceBinding Name}" />
                      </Grid>
                      <Rectangle Name="line" Height="1" Margin="5,0,5,0" Fill="{DynamicResource Col_Theme}" Opacity="1" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" />
                      <i:Interaction.Triggers>
                        <i:EventTrigger EventName="MouseDown">
                          <UIHelper:ParamsEventCommand Command="{Binding ItemClickCommand}" />
                        </i:EventTrigger>
                      </i:Interaction.Triggers>
                    </Grid>
                  </Border>
                  <Border CornerRadius="2" BorderThickness="1" IsHitTestVisible="False" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource Popup.BorderBrush}">
                    <Rectangle Height="28" Margin="5,6,5,6" Fill="#FFFFFFFF" Opacity="0.1" VerticalAlignment="Center" StrokeThickness="2" />
                    <UIElement.Effect>
                      <DropShadowEffect BlurRadius="3" Direction="280" Opacity="0.09" ShadowDepth="2" Color="Orange" />
                    </UIElement.Effect>
                  </Border>
                </Grid>
              </StackPanel>
            </Popup>
          </Grid>
        </Grid>
      </DataTemplate>
